info.title: Polaris Core
info.description: Business core of Polaris, a personal job-hunting agent for LLM and Agent internships. Every model call and tool call is traced (tokens, latency, cost) and every job can be traced back to its source. Read-only tools are also exposed over MCP (streamable HTTP) at /mcp/ with a bearer token.
